analyst_view.overall: Arsenal are 3rd in the league phase on 10 points and unbeaten in 15 league-phase games. Dortmund are 12th on 9 points after beating Betis 2-1 on 4 November. Arsenal are still without Bukayo Saka: Arteta said on 20 November that his thigh injury needs about eight weeks and he is four weeks in. Martin Zubimendi is also out for a few weeks with a hamstring injury from Spain duty. Neither player is on the numbers' missing list, but Saka has already missed five games, so Arsenal's recent form partly reflects his absence. Dortmund have Guirassy (thigh strain) and Anton (muscle) as doubts, and Can, Konstantelias and Lerma are long-term absentees. No referee has been named yet, and the numbers count only form (momentum).

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. I lean slightly lower to about 2.5. Arsenal are without Saka, their main creator, for several more weeks, and Dortmund may lack Guirassy, their top striker, who has been out with a thigh strain since 4 November. The numbers already see Arsenal's quieter recent scoring (about -2% on each side), so I keep the size small.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, with Arsenal around 6.3. Arsenal win plenty of corners from set-piece pressure even without Saka, and Dortmund's recent corner counts are already in the numbers (+1 to +3% momentum). Nothing new points either way, so I stay at 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards. Arsenal's recent card count is above normal and the numbers already add about +10% for it. No referee has been named yet. I see no reason to move, so I stay at 3.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.9 shots, with Dortmund's busy recent shooting already counted (+11%). Without Saka and Zubimendi, Arsenal have less invention in the final third, and Guirassy's fitness is uncertain. I trim slightly to about 24.4.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target. Arsenal's on-target count has dipped while Saka has been out, and the numbers already take off about 3% for that. With him still weeks away and Dortmund's main striker doubtful, I go a little lower, to about 8.1.
